title: Do zero ao farm em 3 passos
concept: A three-phase speedrun HUD: PHASE_01 configure seu bot (illustrated brand panel, toggles click on), PHASE_02 defina os waypoints (route drawn over a stylized map, the robot walks the loop), PHASE_03 ligue e acompanhe pelo celular (phone: ONLINE, PC desligado, shiny alarm example), then RUN COMPLETO with a real customer line 'Teu bot é mt bom e fácil configurar' and an honest fine print.
claims: alarmes no celular e notificações no WhatsApp
o suporte te ajuda a configurar

notes: Panel, map and phone are stylized brand illustrations labelled 'ilustração' / 'exemplo' (the site's panel screenshots show an old UI and are not used). Phases mirror the site's 'Como funciona' (Configure seu Bot / Defina Waypoints) + the phone panel. The real print facil-configurar.png is a 1080x85 strip whose text would be ~21 px on screen, so the line is also set large in type, verbatim and trimmed ('Teu bot é mt bom e fácil configurar'; the message continues 'parabéns pelo trampo'), with the strip itself shown beneath as proof. Fine print '*na vida real leva mais que 10s — o suporte ajuda' keeps the speedrun joke honest.
